verdict.rationale: Devin is a coding agent, so automatically opening a pull request when a task completes is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the pack documents Devin opening PRs or a setting to do so on completion. The closest item, Devin Review with Auto-Fix, covers responding to review comments and CI failures on existing code reviews, which is a related but different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes
